claim: Sunlight looks white, but it is made up of all the colours of the rainbow
Blue light travels in shorter waves than red light
The gas molecules in the air scatter blue light in all directions more than the other colours, which is why the sky looks blue most of the time
Near the horizon the sky looks lighter blue or white, because that light has passed through more air and its blue has been scattered many times in many directions
On 2026-11-12 NVIDIA's board announced that Jensen Huang resigned as President, Chief Executive Officer and member of the Board, effective immediately
NVIDIA's announcement gives no reason for Huang's resignation; reasons circulate only in media reports (alleged relationships, alleged espionage link), which NVIDIA has not confirmed
caveat: Never state the media allegations as fact; Huang denied the espionage allegation per press reports
